questions.stem: Which loop type guarantees at least one execution of the loop body?
questions.explanation: The do-while loop executes the loop body first and then checks the condition, ensuring at least one execution.

distractorRationale.a: A while loop checks the condition before executing the loop body.
distractorRationale.b: A for loop also checks the condition before executing the loop body.
distractorRationale.d: A do-while loop does guarantee at least one execution.

questions.stem: Which loop type is best suited for reading input until a sentinel value is encountered?

distractorRationale.b: A for loop is not ideal for sentinel-driven loops.
distractorRationale.c: A do-while loop might execute once before checking the sentinel.
distractorRationale.d: A while loop is suitable for sentinel-driven loops.
